title: Tablet Newspaper (1994)
summary: A 1994 video from Knight Ridder showing a concept for a tablet newspaper with a rounded-corner rectangular touchscreen. It was reposted by Matt Novak of Paleofuture.
why: Cited during the 2011 Apple v. Samsung tablet disputes as prior art for the iPad's design.

quote.text: video of the Knight Ridder Newspad (from 1994!), that was used as a prior design by the court
